correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all forbidden monochromatic triples from geodesics of length <=5 in the actual 2n-vertex prism graphs. Independent canonical color-label search proves no coloring with one fewer color for n=3..9 with exact search node counts (2,2,13,11,125,88,3942), and no 3-coloring of the five-rung straight ladder (88 nodes). The actual source witnesses provide upper colorings for n=3..15 and special n=17,21; their full JSON and source verifier were inspected, and the four-periodic 12-column witness was independently checked against its geodesic triple hypergraph. For n>=10 all length<=5 geodesics lie in six cyclic columns; the 5-column straight ladder is isometric and the periodic five-state return allows insertion of four columns in all four residue classes using seeds 12,14,15,21 plus exceptional 10,11,13,17. Finite searches certify finite obstructions/witnesses; locality and pumping are the infinite proof.
